name: Livingston County, KY
findings: Livingston County has 25 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Livingston County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Livingston County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Livingston County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.
